executable_defects_remediated.defect: Board and market segment were not effective-dated.
executable_defects_remediated.what_was_wrong: md_listings.board_code and md_listings.market_segment were single mutable columns. A board move could only be recorded by overwriting one of them, which changed the answer for every historical date at once, and the universe query filtered on the current segment — so a listing that was Regular on T and moved afterwards silently left T's universe. That is the defect the is_active boundary describes, in two columns it does not name.
executable_defects_remediated.reproduced_before_fixing: ListingBoardAndSegmentTemporalityTest was written first and run against the unmodified code: 1 failure and 7 errors, the first of them 'no such table: md_listing_boards'. The gap was not inferred from reading.
executable_defects_remediated.fix: Additive migration 2026_08_22_000001 creates md_listing_boards with an effective interval, known time, retraction, provenance and change reason, and opens one interval per existing listing from the dates that listing already records. TemporalIdentityRepository resolves board and segment from that table, the legacy projection opens the interval, and two intervals covering one date raise LISTING_BOARD_CONTEXT_AMBIGUOUS. The columns on md_listings remain as the cached current-state projection MD-S057-R0017 permits, and nothing resolves history from them.
executable_defects_remediated.deployment: php artisan migrate applied it to the reachable database: 977 listings, 977 intervals opened, 0 listings left without one, 0 intervals disagreeing with their listing dates.

executable_defects_remediated.defect: The conditional OPERATOR_ENTERED authority class was unconditional at resolution.
executable_defects_remediated.what_was_wrong: MD-S052-R0012 permits an operator-entered row to establish membership only with an explicit authoritative reference, a named operator, and a governed reason code. appendMembership() enforced that triple; the resolver did not, and operator_name and reason_code are nullable with no database constraint binding them to the class. A row arriving by any other route resolved as authoritative membership. The condition was checked exactly where it was already satisfied.
executable_defects_remediated.reproduced_before_fixing: SectorSourceAuthorityClassResolutionTest inserted the rows directly and ran against the unmodified code: 2 failures. An ungoverned operator row established sector 'G', and — a second consequence the test found rather than predicted — a governed row covering the same date was reported as an overlap conflict because the ungoverned row was counted as a rival.
executable_defects_remediated.fix: operatorGovernanceSatisfied() filters ungoverned operator rows out before supersession and coverage are computed, so such a row can neither resolve a sector nor supersede a row that can, and an otherwise uncovered date reports SECTOR_OPERATOR_GOVERNANCE_INCOMPLETE rather than a bare SECTOR_MEMBERSHIP_UNKNOWN.
executable_defects_remediated.production_data_effect: None. The reachable database holds 971 DERIVED_REFERENCE and 721 EXCHANGE_AUTHORITATIVE membership rows and no OPERATOR_ENTERED rows, so the change closes the hole without altering any current resolution.

executable_defects_remediated.defect: A run without a config snapshot acquired with no context at all.
executable_defects_remediated.what_was_wrong: MarketDataPipelineService chose between two acquisition calls on empty($run->config_snapshot_id). The fallback passed no context: no knowledge cutoff, no run identity, and no enforce_temporal_mapping, so provider symbols fell back to adapter suffix rendering and the universe resolved from current state. MD-S055-R0012 forbids exactly that substitution, and the branch had outlived its cause — every run created by EodRunRepository now resolves a config snapshot, so the branch only survived to degrade the runs that reached it.
executable_defects_remediated.fix: The context is now unconditional; a run without a snapshot passes a null snapshot id rather than dropping the knowledge cutoff and the mapping requirement.
executable_defects_remediated.test_effect: Five MarketDataPipelineServiceTest expectations pinned the two-argument call and now pin the four-argument one, including the enforcement flag itself. Pinning it is stronger proof than the shape they replaced.

semantic_corrections: The reference set was not derived from structure. It excluded hard prohibitions — 'no other classification system may be stored as IDX-IC', 'overlapping mappings to different instruments are invalid', and the whole failure-behavior list of the mapping contract — while including their siblings, and it excluded two of the three acceptance criteria while marking the third required.

Every remaining reference row is one of five structural classes: a colon-terminated introducer, a bare label, a table header, or a cross-contract pointer. The gate re-derives the class from the rule text, so a row whose text becomes a predicate can no longer stay excluded.

MD-S055-R0025, the historical replay rule, was OPTIONAL_CAPABILITY / OPTIONAL_NOT_REQUESTED. An as-known replay contract row cannot be an unrequested optional capability while MD-B18 exists as a mandatory stage to build it; it is now MANDATORY at MD-B18.

Twenty predicates name observations, publications, coverage, replay, or sector-derived measures. Naming them here does not make them provable here, so they moved to MD-B07, MD-B10, MD-B14, MD-B15, MD-B17, MD-B18, and MD-B21 with MD-B05 retained as supporting stage.
MD-B05 joined the classification gate's normalized-stage set; the pending mixed-classification backlog fell from 579 to 552.

documented_interval_convention.why: MD-S057-R0013 and MD-S052-R0018 permit an exclusive or inclusive interval end and require the choice to be one documented convention. The convention was consistent in code and stated nowhere, which is the half of the requirement that was not met.
documented_interval_convention.identity_records: md_listing_symbols, md_listing_boards, md_provider_symbol_mappings — DATETIME, exclusive end.
documented_interval_convention.sector_membership: ticker_sector_memberships — DATE, inclusive end; a reclassification effective R closes the prior row at R-1.
documented_interval_convention.asserted_by: Both conventions are pinned on each side of a boundary by execution, so a change breaks a test rather than silently shifting historical answers by one session.
